title: The Ratchet of Logic
summary: At the independent The Omega Institute, a 16-state computation illustrates joint kernels and structural novelty. A separate frozen counterexample refutes a Fredkin entangling-power conjecture. Read its 223,231-theorem snapshot, distinguish Alpöge’s classical RH and Dirichlet GRH proof from the Institute’s 8,490-shard replay, and locate four open questions.
summary_zh: 通过 16 个状态的算例理解联合核，再看独立研究机构 The Omega Institute 的冻结结果与 223,231 条定理快照。分别辨认 Alpöge 的经典黎曼猜想与狄利克雷广义黎曼猜想证明、研究院的 8,490 分片复现及四个开放问题。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing
style: dual-polarity optical glass · ratchet, computed kernel, proof provenance and open questions
